macos.rationale: macOS (download or Toolbox), Linux (install script or Toolbox) and Windows (Toolbox) per the install page (2026-09-30). The July 2026 post (date from URL path) links Windows x64 and ARM64 downloads whose URLs carry type=preview. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud), Air in JetBrains IDEs (EAP, Air plugin).

The July 2026 post (date from URL path) links Windows x64 and ARM64 downloads whose URLs carry type=preview. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud), Air in JetBrains IDEs (EAP, Air plugin).

linux.rationale: macOS (download or Toolbox), Linux (install script or Toolbox) and Windows (Toolbox) per the install page (2026-09-30). The July 2026 post (date from URL path) links Windows x64 and ARM64 downloads whose URLs carry type=preview. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud), Air in JetBrains IDEs (EAP, Air plugin).

web-client.rationale: Air Teams runs in the browser at air.jetbrains.cloud and is the only surface with all features; the product page still invites early-access sign-up and rollout is gradual. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud), Air in JetBrains IDEs (EAP, Air plugin).

local.rationale: Air in IDEs sessions run on your machine by default (Local or Temporary Worktree).

vendor-cloud.rationale: Air Teams cloud tasks run in a JetBrains-managed container on a cloud VM.

worktree.rationale: Git Worktree option in the Air app with .air/worktree.json setup. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud).

container.rationale: Docker option locally, which needs Docker Desktop with a valid license; the July 2026 release post adds Windows support. Cloud environments are Docker containers on a cloud VM (configure-environments, 2026-10-05). Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud).

vm.rationale: The documented cloud environment has a selectable VM with explicit CPU, RAM and disk sizes, alongside its Docker container.

parallel-runs.rationale: Several tasks run at once in one or across all open projects. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud), Air in JetBrains IDEs (EAP, Air plugin).

unattended-triggers.rationale: Triggers run at a time on selected days or repeat at a fixed interval. Scope: Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud).

roles.rationale: Organization administrator role runs setup and Console policies apply per user, group or service account. Scope: Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud), Air Governance (JetBrains Central Console).

pr-workflow.rationale: Cloud tasks: a person opens the pull request from the pushed task branch with Create PR in the task or directly in the VCS provider; Air Teams acts through the user's GitHub app authorization or GitLab api scope. Local tasks: the user commits and pushes, or creates a branch and opens a pull request. Automations: only Create a PR opens one; Push to source branch and Push to new branch push without opening a pull request, and No code changes commits nothing. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud). Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to jetbrains-air:SHIP-03; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

review-ui.rationale: Merged Task Changes diff and commits on the task branch. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air Teams (browser, air.jetbrains.cloud).

license.rationale: JetBrains Air EAP User Agreement v1.0 (effective 2025-12-01): section 3.1 allows installation on any number of machines free of charge during the EAP; section 3.3 sets proprietary restrictions. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client).

free-tier.rationale: Air app EAP software is free under its EAP term; Governance Basic is free, but JetBrains AI usage still consumes credits. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air in JetBrains IDEs (EAP, Air plugin), Air Governance (JetBrains Central Console).

starting-price.rationale: Air app EAP software is free under its EAP term; Governance Basic is free, but JetBrains AI usage still consumes credits. Scope: Air app (standalone desktop client), Air in JetBrains IDEs (EAP, Air plugin), Air Governance (JetBrains Central Console).

claude-code.rationale: Air in IDEs runs installed Claude Code in its terminal surface. This does not equate the restricted chat SDK integration with a subscription-supported terminal session. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to jetbrains-air:ACC-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

codex.rationale: Explicitly listed local Air agent. Gemini CLI is temporarily unavailable for Cloud tasks; no hands-on mixed-harness result is claimed. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to jetbrains-air:ACC-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

gemini-cli.rationale: Explicitly listed local Air agent. Gemini CLI is temporarily unavailable for Cloud tasks; no hands-on mixed-harness result is claimed. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to jetbrains-air:ACC-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

opencode.rationale: The official July release explicitly adds this ACP agent to the local Air app. It is not an Air Teams Cloud agent. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to jetbrains-air:ACC-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

pi.rationale: The official July release explicitly adds this ACP agent to the local Air app. It is not an Air Teams Cloud agent. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to jetbrains-air:ACC-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

cursor.rationale: The Air in IDEs product page explicitly names Cursor among runnable local coding agents.

laptop-independent.rationale: Cloud tasks keep running after the browser tab closes.

per-seat.rationale: Business $20 per AI seat per month.

usage-based.rationale: Usage billed separately in AI credits, 1 credit per USD provider cost.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete governance plan table offers recurring paid seats and usage credits, with no no-paid-plan plan.

one-time.rationale: The complete governance plan table offers recurring paid seats and usage credits, with no one-time plan.

subscription.rationale: Business governance seats carry a recurring monthly or annual fee; AI usage is charged separately.

byok.rationale: Business/Enterprise support centrally managed model keys, and local IDE clients accept an own API key on any plan; cloud tasks use JetBrains AI.

paid-from.rationale: Business $20 per seat per month, monthly billing available. Rechecked against the eligible finding on 2026-11-13: this paid offering remains distinct from no paid plan. Original source-check date retained; independent mapping review cleared for the revised definition.

byo-subscription.rationale: The IDE client explicitly reuses existing coding-agent subscriptions, including Claude Code native terminal login. This leaves the legacy standalone-app Claude Agent contradiction unresolved.

sso.rationale: The first-party Air Governance page explicitly documents SSO/access control on Basic and higher plans; future IdP/SCIM provisioning is separate.
